DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出発前に地図をご覧ですか。帰りの道で確認したいところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the map before departure? Is there anything you want to check about the return route?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車を返すとき、今入ってきた入口へ戻ればよいのか分かりません。地図では矢印が二つあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内図に矢印が二つあり入ってきた入口へ返すのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: When returning the car, I don't know whether to come back to the entrance I just used. There are two arrows on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to return through the arrival entrance because the map has two arrows. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内図の返却用の矢印を見ましょう。どちらの方向から戻る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's look at the return arrow on this map. Which direction do you plan to come back from?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 市内の宿から戻る予定ですが、途中で買い物に寄るかもしれません。最後に通る道はまだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宿から戻るが買い物の可能性で最後の道は未定だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: From our accommodation in town, but we might stop for shopping. We haven't decided the final road yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you will return from the accommodation but the final road is undecided because of possible shopping. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 経路が変わっても探せるよう、返却入口の目印を地図に付けましょう。入口の表示も確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's mark a landmark for the return entrance so you can find it even if your route changes. You can also check the entrance sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返却の文字のある入口ですね。地図に印を付けて、同乗する友人にも見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返却表示の入口を地図に記し友人へ見せたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The entrance marked 'Returns,' right? I'd like to mark it on the map and show my friend riding with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mark the returns entrance on the map and say you want to show your friend. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人と共有すると確認しやすいですね。返却の時刻は、お手元の予約内容と照合しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sharing it should help you check. Have you compared the return time with your reservation details?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予約の時刻は確認しました。間に合うか分からなくなったら、どこへ連絡すればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約時刻を確認し間に合うか不明な際の連絡先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've checked the reservation time. If I become unsure whether I'll make it, where should I call?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the reservation time and ask whom to contact if you may not arrive on time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約書の連絡先をご覧ください。状況を伝えて、対応は担当者に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the contact on your reservation document. Explain the situation and check the response with the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返却入口に印を付けて友人と共有し、予定が変わったら予約書の連絡先へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口の印を共有し予定変更時は予約書の連絡先へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll mark the return entrance and share it with my friend, and consult the reservation contact if plans change.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will share the marked entrance and contact the reservation number if plans change. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では地図を車内でも見られるようにお持ちください。出発の準備を確認しましょう。それでは、安全にお気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then keep the map where you can also see it in the car. Let's check you're ready to depart. Drive safely, and have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 贈り物をお探しですか。お渡しする人数は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for gifts? Have you decided how many recipients?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人に一つずつ渡したいです。この後歩くので、見た目より軽いものを探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人に一つずつ贈り徒歩で持つため軽さを重視すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: One each for two people. I'll be walking afterward, so I'm looking for light weight rather than appearance.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want one gift each for two people and prioritize light weight because you'll carry them on foot. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの二種類を持ち比べられます。箱入りと袋入りで、大きさと重さが違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can compare holding these two types. Boxed and bagged versions differ in size and weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 箱のほうは軽いですが、かばんに入らなさそうです。袋入りを二つ並べて見てもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 軽い箱は収まらなそうなので袋二つを並べたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The box is light, but doesn't look as though it'll fit in my bag. May I see two bagged ones side by side?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to compare two bagged versions because the light box may not fit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 並べてみましょう。二つとも同じ品でよいですか、それとも相手によって変えたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's put them together. Do you want the same item for both or different items depending on the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ品にしたいです。二つ買った場合の合計を、表示を見ながら確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ商品二つの合計を表示で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The same item. I'd like to check the displayed total for buying two.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to confirm the total for two identical items from the display. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 値札と包装の案内を一緒に見ましょう。渡すときは、それぞれ別の包みが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's look at the price tags and wrapping instructions together. Do they need separate wrapping when given?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つずつ渡すので、別の包みにしたいです。包装で重くなるなら、簡単な包みを考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別々に包みたいが重くなるなら簡単な包装を選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll give them individually, so I'd like separate packages. If wrapping makes them heavy, I'll consider simple wrapping.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want separate wrapping but will choose simple packaging if it adds weight. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 包みの見本も比べられます。持ち帰るかばんの大きさを考えて選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can compare wrapping samples too. Let's choose with the size of your carrying bag in mind.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋入り二つの合計と包みを確認し、かばんに収まるか見てから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合計と包みとかばんへの収まりを確認してから決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the two bagged items' total and wrapping, then see whether they fit in my bag before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will decide after checking the total, packaging, and fit in your bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望に合う組合せを探しましょう。決まりましたら会計へお持ちください。お土産が喜ばれますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's find a combination that fits your needs. Take it to checkout once decided. I hope the gifts are appreciated.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 教室の案内をご覧になったのですね。どんな場面の日本語を練習したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've read the class information. In what situations would you like to practice Japanese?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事で説明を聞き取れないとき、もう一度聞く言い方を練習したいです。勤務の時間が毎週変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事の聞き返しを練習したく勤務時間が毎週変わると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to practice asking again when I don't catch explanations at work. My work hours change every week.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain wanting to practice clarification at work and having weekly-changing work hours. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 聞き返す練習の希望を伺いました。参加できそうな日は、勤務表で分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I've noted your wish to practice asking again. Can your work schedule show which days you might attend?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今月の勤務表ならあります。案内の日と比べると、参加できる週とできない週があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務表と案内日を比べて参加できない週もあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have this month's schedule. Comparing it with the advertised days, there are weeks I can attend and weeks I can't.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Compare your work schedule with the class dates and say some weeks are unavailable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務表と教室の予定を並べてみましょう。まず一回の参加について相談しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's put the work and class schedules side by side. Would you like to discuss attending once first?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一回参加して内容を知りたいです。途中から来てもよいかは、申し込む前に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一回参加して内容を知りたく途中参加の条件も確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like one visit to learn the content. Before applying, I also want to check whether arriving midway is allowed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to attend once to learn the content and check conditions for joining midway. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中参加の扱いは、この教室の案内で確認しましょう。参加できない週の勉強についても気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check this class's instructions on joining midway. Are you also concerned about studying during weeks you can't attend?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、休んだ週に何を練習すればよいか知りたいです。次の授業についていけるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休んだ週の練習と次の授業への不安を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'd like to know what to practice in weeks I'm absent. I'm worried whether I can keep up with the next lesson.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss practice during missed weeks and concern about the next class. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 授業の内容に合わせて相談できます。実際に困った説明を、覚えている範囲で書いてきてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can discuss it based on lesson content. Could you write down an actual difficult explanation as far as you remember?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 聞き取れなかった説明をメモし、勤務表と一緒に持ってきます。参加方法も案内で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 聞き取れなかった説明のメモと勤務表を持参し参加案内を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the explanation I couldn't catch and bring it with my work schedule. I'll also check participation methods in the information.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will bring notes on unclear explanations and your work schedule and check attendance instructions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: メモがあると練習を相談しやすくなります。日程が決まったらお知らせください。教室でお会いできるのを楽しみにしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Notes will make it easier to discuss practice. Please tell us once you've settled a date. We look forward to seeing you in class.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの机が気になりますか。どこでお使いになる予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you interested in this desk? Where do you plan to use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋で勉強する机にしたいです。ただ、部屋の入口が狭いので、運び込めるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勉強用に机を検討するが部屋の入口が狭いと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: As a study desk in my room. But the room entrance is narrow, so I'm worried it won't fit through.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you're considering a study desk but your room entrance is narrow. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 机の寸法表示を見ましょう。入口の幅は測ってありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's look at the desk's dimensions. Have you measured the entrance width?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ測っていません。机の幅と奥行きをメモしてから、家の入口を測りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口をまだ測っておらず机の幅と奥行きを記録したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I'd like to note the desk's width and depth, then measure my entrance at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the entrance is unmeasured and you want to record the desk width and depth. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 測り比べてから判断できますね。机そのものの状態で確認したい点もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can decide after comparing measurements. Is there anything else you want to check about the desk's condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 天板の傷は見えますが、引き出しが引っ掛からずに動くか確かめたいです。触ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 傷は見えているが引き出しの動きを試してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can see scratches on the top, but want to check whether the drawers move without catching. May I touch it?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you see the scratches and ask to try the drawers' movement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで一緒に動きを見ましょう。購入後の条件は、表示を確認して説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the movement together here. I'll check the displayed post-purchase conditions and explain them.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家で大きさが合わなかった場合の扱いも、買う前に知りたいです。持ち帰り方も相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: サイズが合わない場合の購入後の条件と持帰り方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before buying, I'd also like to know what happens if it doesn't fit at home. Can I ask about taking it home too?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about post-purchase conditions if the size doesn't fit and about transport home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 寸法が合わない場合の扱いと搬出方法を、店の案内で確認しましょう。今すぐ購入を決めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check store instructions for dimensions not fitting and taking it out. Do you want to decide on a purchase now?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は寸法と状態を確認するだけにします。入口を測り、購入後の条件も理解してから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は確認に留め入口の採寸と条件の理解後に決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll just check dimensions and condition. I'll decide after measuring the entrance and understanding the post-purchase conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll limit today to checking and decide after measuring the entrance and understanding conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ゆっくり確かめてください。寸法のメモをお持ちになり、また比較にいらしてください。お部屋に合う机が見つかりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take your time checking. Bring your dimension notes and visit again to compare. I hope you find a desk that fits your room.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご利用は何名様の予定ですか。皆様おそろいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many people plan to use the room? Is everyone here?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三人の予定ですが、今は二人です。もう一人が遅れるので、先に入る場合の料金を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三人中二人だけ到着し先に入る場合の料金を聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Three planned, but only two now. One will be late, so I'd like to ask the price if we enter first.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say only two of three have arrived and ask the cost of entering ahead. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 途中から加わる方の扱いを、料金表で確認しましょう。終了する時刻は皆様同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the price list for someone joining later. Will everyone finish at the same time?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ時刻に出たいです。最後に来る友人の分がどう計算されるか、入る前に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 全員同時に出る予定で遅れる人の計算を事前確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: We want to leave together. Before entering, I'd like to know how the late friend's portion is calculated.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say everyone plans the same finish and you want to check the late arrival's calculation beforehand. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 計算の条件を説明します。利用する長さは、もう決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll explain the calculation conditions. Have you decided how long to use the room?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一時間を考えていますが、料金を聞いてから決めたいです。延長せずに出る場合の合図も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一時間を検討し料金確認後に決め終了の合図も知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: We're considering an hour but want to hear the price before deciding. I'd also like to know the signal for leaving without extending.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Consider an hour, decide after pricing, and ask about the ending signal. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 終了前の案内方法を確認しましょう。飲み物の注文についても説明が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check how we notify you before the end. Do you also need an explanation about ordering drinks?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 飲み物が料金に含まれるのか、別に注文するのか分かりません。友人の分も一緒に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料金に含まれるか別注文かを友人の分も含め確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't know whether drinks are included or separately ordered. I'd like to check my friend's portion too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether drinks are included or separately ordered, including your friend's. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 人数と飲み物の条件を合わせて、合計の見方をご案内します。遅れる方にも内容を伝えられそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain reading the total together with people and drink conditions. Can you also tell the late arrival?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人に途中参加の計算と飲み物の条件を伝えます。全員が同じ終了時刻だと分かってから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 途中参加と飲み物の条件を共有し終了時刻の理解後に申し込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my friend the late-joining calculation and drink conditions. I'll apply once everyone understands we have the same finish time.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Share late-arrival and drink conditions and say you will apply after understanding the common finish time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では条件を確認してから部屋を決めましょう。おそろいになりましたら、三人で楽しい時間をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's check the conditions before choosing the room. Once all three are together, enjoy your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 靴を受け取られたところですね。サイズの表示はご希望のものと合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've just received the shoes. Do the displayed sizes match your request?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右は二十五センチですが、左は二十四センチと書いてあります。履く前に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右と左の表示が異なるため履く前に確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The right says twenty-five centimeters, but the left says twenty-four. Could you check before I put them on?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a check before wearing because right and left size labels differ. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示が違いますね。こちらで組合せを確かめます。ご希望は左右とも二十五センチでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The labels differ. We'll check the pair. Do you want twenty-five centimeters for both?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左右とも二十五センチでお願いします。交換した後、座って履き心地を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左右二十五センチを希望し交換後に座って履き心地を見たいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Twenty-five for both, please. After exchanging, I'd like to sit down and check the fit.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request both shoes in twenty-five centimeters and a seated fit check after exchange. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 交換した靴をお持ちします。受付の内容は、何名で何ゲームのご予定でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll bring replacement shoes. For the registration, how many people and games did you plan?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人で一ゲームの予定です。初めて来たので、自分たちのレーンがどこかもまだ分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人一ゲームを予定しレーンの場所を知らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two people, one game. It's our first visit, so we don't know where our lane is yet either.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you plan two people and one game and don't know the lane location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付内容と案内を見て、レーンを確認しましょう。同行の方はどちらで待っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check your lane using the registration and guide. Where is your companion waiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付横の椅子にいます。二人で案内を聞いてから、レーンへ移動したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付横で待つ友人と一緒に説明後移動したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: On the chair beside reception. We'd like to hear the explanation together before moving to the lane.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to move after hearing instructions together with the friend waiting beside reception. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お二人に場所と用品の案内をします。靴が合わないと感じたら、始める前に知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain the location and equipment to both of you. If the shoes feel wrong, tell us before starting.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 交換した靴の表示と履き心地を見て、友人と一緒に場所の説明を聞きます。まだ合わなければ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交換後に表示と履き心地を見て友人と案内を聞き不適合なら相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the replacement shoes' labels and fit and hear the location explanation with my friend. If they still don't fit, I'll ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check labels and comfort after exchange, listen with your friend, and consult if unsuitable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では先に靴を交換しましょう。準備が整ったらレーンへご案内しますので、お二人でボウリングをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's exchange the shoes first. Once ready, we'll guide you to your lane. Enjoy bowling together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お料理についてお尋ねでしたね。どの写真をご覧になっていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You wanted to ask about the food. Which photo were you looking at?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この野菜料理を三人で分けたいです。写真の量が一人分なのか、皆で分ける量なのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 野菜料理を三人で分けたく写真の量が一人用か分からないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: We'd like to share this vegetable dish among three. I can't tell whether the pictured amount is for one person or sharing.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to share the vegetable dish among three and aren't sure if the photo is one portion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真だけでは量が分かりにくいですね。実際の盛り付けについて確認します。ほかに選んでいる料理はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's hard to judge quantity from the photo alone. I'll check the actual serving. Are you choosing other dishes too?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 焼いた料理も一つ頼むつもりです。最初からたくさん頼まず、量を見て追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 焼いた料理も一つ考え量を見て追加したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We also plan one grilled dish. Rather than order a lot at first, we'd like to see the amount and add more.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you're considering one grilled dish too and want to add after seeing the quantity. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最初の品を見てから追加する案ですね。料理の味付けで希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You plan to add after seeing the first dishes, then. Any seasoning preferences?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 野菜料理のたれを別にできるか聞きたいです。三人で好みが違うので、それぞれで付けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 好みが違う三人のためたれを別にできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to ask whether the vegetable dish's sauce can be separate. All three of us have different tastes, so we'd each like to add our own.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for separate sauce because the three diners have different tastes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: たれを別にできるか厨房に確認します。取り分けのお皿も必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with the kitchen whether the sauce can be separate. Do you also need sharing plates?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さい皿を三枚お願いしたいです。熱い料理を分けるときに使う道具も、あれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小皿三枚と熱い料理に使う取り分け道具を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Three small plates, please. If there are utensils for dividing hot dishes, please tell us too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for three small plates and utensils for sharing hot food. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取り分けに使うものを確認してお持ちします。たれの確認ができてから注文を決めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check and bring serving utensils. Would you like to decide the order after the sauce check?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: たれを別にできるかと料理の量を聞いてから決めます。まず二品を頼み、足りなければ後で追加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: たれと量を聞いて二品から注文し足りなければ追加すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll decide after hearing about separate sauce and the portion size. We'll begin with two dishes and add later if not enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask about sauce and portions, order two dishes to start, and add if needed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認して戻りますので、少々お待ちください。皆様で分けやすいよう相談しましょう。どうぞゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-NANKOKU-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check and return; please wait a moment. Let's discuss making it easy to share. Relax and enjoy your time.

DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗船をご希望ですね。今日の運航状況を確認しますので、荷物について先に伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to board the boat. I'll check today's service; may I ask about your luggage first?

DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。この大きなリュックと長い傘を持っています。どちらも船へ持ち込めるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きなリュックと長い傘を示して扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. I have this large backpack and long umbrella. I'd like to know whether both can go on the boat.
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the large backpack and long umbrella and discuss their handling. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 大きさを見て乗船担当へ確認します。リュックには、手元に置いておきたい物も入っていますか。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check their size with the boarding staff. Does the backpack also contain things you want to keep close at hand?

DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯電話と財布が入っています。必要な物を小さな袋に移してから、荷物の置き方を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話と財布を分けてから置き方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-04.translation: My phone and wallet. I'd like to move necessities to a small bag before asking where to put the luggage.
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate your phone and wallet before checking where to place luggage. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 整理しておくと相談しやすいですね。傘の扱いも含め、置き場所を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Organizing will make it easier to discuss. We'll check storage, including the umbrella, before advising you.

DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 傘は閉じてあります。案内が出るまで、乗り場の近くで待っていてよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運航案内が出るまでどこで待つか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-06.translation: The umbrella is closed. May I wait near the boarding point until the information is available?
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to wait until service information is available. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗り場の前は空けて、こちらの案内板のそばでお待ちください。運航が決まったら声をかけます。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep the front of the boarding point clear and wait by this information board. We'll call when the service decision is made.

DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内板のそばに移ります。救命胴衣についても、乗る前に付け方を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内板へ移ってから乗船前の説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll move by the board. Could you also explain how to put on the life jacket before boarding?
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move to the information board and request the pre-boarding explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗船担当から実物を使って説明します。説明を受けてから、乗れる状況かどうかも含めて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-09.translation: The boarding staff will demonstrate with an actual life jacket. After the explanation, let's also check whether boarding conditions allow you to go.

DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 運航と荷物の案内を待ち、救命胴衣の説明を受けてから乗ります。まだ船へは進まず、ここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 運航と荷物と救命胴衣の案内を受けるまで待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll await service and luggage information and board after the life-jacket explanation. I won't go toward the boat yet; I'll wait here.
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait until receiving service, luggage, and life-jacket guidance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。私は乗船担当に確認してきますので、案内板のところでお待ちください。それでは、後ほどご案内します。
DLG-SC-KCH-SHIMANTO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I'll check with boarding staff, so please wait by the information board. We'll guide you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 区画のご相談ですね。お使いになるテントについて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about a campsite pitch. Please tell me about the tent you'll use.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: テントは四人用ですが、二人で使います。人数だけでなく、張ったときの大きさも確認したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人数だけで区画を選ばず張る寸法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a four-person tent, but two of us will use it. Besides headcount, should I check the size when pitched too?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check pitched dimensions rather than choosing a site by headcount alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、ロープを張る範囲も含めて考えましょう。寸法がわかる説明書をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, let's include the area needed for guy ropes. Do you have instructions showing dimensions?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯電話に説明書があります。テント本体の幅だけメモしていたので、ロープの範囲も調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ロープまで含めた必要範囲を調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instructions are on my phone. I only noted the tent body's width, so I'll also look up the rope area.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the required area including ropes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その情報で区画の表示と見比べましょう。調理に火を使う予定もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's compare that information with the pitch dimensions. Do you also plan to use fire for cooking?

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さな調理器具を持ってきました。どこでも使えると思わず、使える場所と条件を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 火を使える場所と条件を事前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I brought a small cooking appliance. Rather than assume it can be used anywhere, I'd like to know permitted locations and conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check where and under what conditions fire is permitted beforehand. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 器具の種類を確認して、今日の掲示と合わせてご案内します。未確認のうちは点火しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the appliance type together with today's notices and explain. Don't light it while permission is unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 器具の写真を見せます。火を使えない場合は、調理しなくても食べられる物に切り替えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真を見せ火を使えない場合の食事を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll show a photo of the appliance. If fire isn't allowed, I'll switch to foods that need no cooking.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the photo and consider food for when fire cannot be used. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件を確認してから準備を決めましょう。区画からはみ出さずに張れるかも、設営前に一緒に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's decide preparations after checking conditions. Before setup, we'll also check together whether it fits without extending beyond the pitch.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ロープを含む寸法と器具の条件を確かめて区画を選びます。確認できないまま設営や点火はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 寸法と火の条件がわかってから区画を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check dimensions including ropes and the appliance conditions before choosing the pitch. I won't set up or light anything while those remain unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide the pitch after learning dimensions and fire conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、説明書と器具の写真を拝見します。準備が整ったら区画へご案内しますね。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let me see the instructions and appliance photo. Once preparations are ready, we'll guide you to the pitch. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は畔の草を集める作業をお願いします。始める前に道具を見ておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today please gather grass on the field ridges. Let's check the tools before starting.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらの長い道具を使うのでしょうか。先が似ている物が二つあって、違いがわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 草を集める作業に使う道具を見分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Do we use this long tool? Two have similar tips, and I don't understand the difference.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Identify the tool to use for gathering grass. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の作業で使うのはこちらです。もう一つは別の担当が使いますので、持っていかないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the one for today's task. Another person uses the other, so don't take it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 使うほうを教えていただけて助かりました。草を集めるのは、田んぼの周り全部ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 道具を確認してから担当する区間を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you for showing the correct one. Are we gathering grass all around the rice field?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the tool and ask which section you are responsible for. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日は目印を置いた区間だけです。水の近くや足元が不安定な所へは進まず、私に知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today only the marked section. Don't proceed near water or onto unstable footing; tell me instead.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 向こうの目印のそばに、ぬかるんだ場所があります。その手前で止めてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不安定な場所の手前で止めるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's a muddy spot near the marker over there. May I stop before it?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether to stop before unstable ground. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そこは私が確認します。手前で止めて、乾いた場所から作業してください。集めた草はこの容器へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll inspect it. Stop before it and work from dry ground. Put gathered grass in this container.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 容器がいっぱいになったら、別の場所へ置けばよいでしょうか。それとも、運ぶ前に声をかけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 草を集めた容器を運ぶ前の連絡を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: When the container is full, should I put it somewhere else, or call before moving it?
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm notifying someone before carrying the container of gathered grass. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず声をかけてください。重さを見て運び方を決めます。道具を通路に寝かせたままにもしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Call first. We'll decide transport based on weight. Don't leave tools lying in the passage either.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 指定の道具で目印の区間だけ集めます。ぬかるみには入らず、容器がいっぱいになったら呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 目印の範囲で作業しぬかるみと満杯の容器を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use the assigned tool and gather only in the marked section. I won't enter the mud and will call when the container is full.
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Work within the marked range and report mud and the full container. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当と確認点がわかりましたね。私はぬかるんだ場所を見てきます。作業中に迷ったら呼んでください。それでは、持ち場に戻ります。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KCH-SHIMANTO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You understand your assignment and checkpoints now. I'll check the muddy area. Call if unsure during work. I'll return to my work area now. Thank you for your efforts.
